svg.title: Srinath Muppala — AI Software Engineer
svg.desc: An animated terminal running neofetch: AI Software Engineer, ML and backend. San Francisco Bay Area, open to relocation. M.S. Computer Science (AI), CU Boulder. Focus: agentic AI, RAG, LLM fine-tuning. Open to full-time AI/ML and software engineering roles.

text.tspan: // I make computers do the boring stuff
// so humans can do the interesting stuff.
SF Bay Area · open to relocation
open to full-time AI/ML & SWE roles
I'm the kind of engineer who sees someone doing the same boring thing twice
and immediately thinks, "There has to be a way to automate this."
